paper_title: Shuttle Between the Instructions and the Parameters of Large Language   Models
caption: : The induction performance of SHIP and SFT on SNI with respect to the number of observed samples. The accuracy is the average accuracy over all seen and unseen tasks.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of two different methods, SHIP and vanilla SFT, based on observed samples. The x-axis represents "observed samples" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 6, with tick marks at each integer interval. The y-axis shows "accuracy" also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.80, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The green line represents the SHIP method, using circle markers and a solid line style. This line shows a consistent trend, starting near 0.82 at observed sample 1 and slightly fluctuating around similar values, ending at 0.83 at observed sample 6. The blue line represents the vanilla SFT method, also with circle markers and a solid line style. This line starts at approximately 0.32 at observed sample 1 and steadily rises, marking its end at about 0.45 at observed sample 6. A legend is placed at the bottom-right corner of the plot, representing the model and its corresponding line format and colors.
